# Load packages

```{r}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)

# NOTE: for the paths below to work, you must set your working directory to the root of the git repository (i.e., where this file lives) and have a data folder in this location
```

# Clean data step-by-step

## Load raw data

```{r}

blp_raw <-    read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/blp_1_raw.csv")
bsq_raw <-    read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/bsq_1_raw.csv")
beq_raw <-    read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/beq_1_raw.csv")
leapq_raw <-  read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/leapq_1_raw.csv")
lsbq_raw <-   read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/lsbq_1_raw.csv")
bds_raw <-    read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/bds_1_raw.csv")
lhq_raw <-    read_csv("data/questionnaires/1_raw/lhq_1_raw.csv")
```

## Add questionnaire prefixes to column names

This step ensures items can be easily traced to their questionnaires after the items have been combined in a single data frame.

```{r}

blp_with_prefixes <- blp_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("blp_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/blp_2_prefix.csv")
  
bsq_with_prefixes <- bsq_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("bsq_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/bsq_2_prefix.csv")

beq_with_prefixes <- beq_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("beq_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/beq_2_prefix.csv")

leapq_with_prefixes <- leapq_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("leapq_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/leapq_2_prefix.csv")

lsbq_with_prefixes <- lsbq_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("lsbq_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/lsbq_2_prefix.csv")

bds_with_prefixes <- bds_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("bds_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/bds_2_prefix.csv")

lhq_with_prefixes <- lhq_raw %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0("lhq_", .), -id) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/2_prefix/lhq_2_prefix.csv")

```

## Correct NA values

Some questions had several choices, the last of which was "NA". These responses were exported from Qualtrics coded as integers (i.e., the upper extreme value of the scale). We want to change these values to "NA".

Similarly, unchecked checkboxes for true/false questions are now coded as "NA" (no response) but should be 0 (i.e., false).

### BSQ: nothing to correct

```{r}

bsq_na_corrected <- bsq_with_prefixes %>%
  write_csv("data/questionnaires/3_NA_corrected/bsq_3_NA_corrected.csv")

```

### BDS

Question that asks "when did you become comfortable speaking your L2?" has a "not yet" option that is currently coded as 5, but should be NA.

```{r}

bds_na_corrected <- bds_with_prefixes 
bds_cols_to_fix <- c('bds_age_comfortable_speaking_L2_1')
bds_na_corrected[bds_cols_to_fix][(bds_na_corrected[bds_cols_to_fix]) == 5] <- NA
write_csv(bds_na_corrected, "data/questionnaires/3_NA_corrected/bds_3_NA_corrected.csv")
```

### BLP

Two questions about "age became comfortable" have options for each year (1 to 20), followed by an NA option. This NA is incorrectly coded as 21 years; here we correct instances of 21 to NA.

```{r}

blp_na_corrected <- blp_with_prefixes

blp_cols_to_fix <- c('blp_L1_age_became_comfortable', 'blp_L2_age_became_comfortable')

blp_na_corrected[blp_cols_to_fix][(blp_na_corrected[blp_cols_to_fix]) == 21] <- NA

write_csv(blp_na_corrected, "data/questionnaires/3_NA_corrected/blp_3_NA_corrected.csv")
```

### BEQ

The BEQ contains questions for which the value of 4 should be NA (language spoken with partner); 3 should be NA (three questions); and 6 should be NA (a few dozen questions).

```{r}
beq_na_corrected <- beq_with_prefixes

# partner_langs - 4 is NA
beq_4_is_na <- c('beq_partner_langs')
beq_na_corrected[beq_4_is_na][(beq_na_corrected[beq_4_is_na]) == 4] <- NA

# personal_diary, if_partner_diff_l1, if_partner_diffargue  - 3 is NA

                 'beq_L1_angry_partner',

                 'beq_L1_swearing',

                 'beq_L2_emotional_weight_swearing',
                 'beq_L1_express_emotions_alone',
```

### LEAP-Q


### LHQ

For the LHQ, unchecked checkboxes should be 0 (i.e., false) instead of NA for questions about L2 learning method.

For questions about use (dreaming and math), 8 should be NA. For questions about language of instruction, 4 should be NA.

```{r}

lhq_na_corrected <- lhq_with_prefixes

cols_with_checkboxes <- c('lhq_L2_learning_method_1', 
                          'lhq_L2_learning_method_2', 
                          'lhq_L2_learning_method_3')

lhq_na_corrected[cols_with_checkboxes][is.na(lhq_na_corrected[cols_with_checkboxes])] <- 0

lhq_8_is_na <- c('lhq_use_dreaming', 
                 'lhq_use_math') 
lhq_na_corrected[lhq_8_is_na][(lhq_na_corrected[lhq_8_is_na]) == 8] <- NA

lhq_4_is_na <- c('lhq_instruction_elementaryschool', 
                 'lhq_instruction_middleschool',
                 'lhq_instruction_highschool',
                 'lhq_instruction_college') 
lhq_na_corrected[lhq_4_is_na][(lhq_na_corrected[lhq_4_is_na]) == 4] <- NA

write_csv(lhq_na_corrected, "data/questionnaires/3_NA_corrected/lhq_3_NA_corrected.csv")

```

## A priori demographic and open-text item removal

All questionnaires but the BSwQ have items—including open-text items and demographic items not directly related to language—that should be removed before the multiple factor analysis. List of items can be found in the `data/items_to_remove/` folder

```{r}

bds_cols_to_remove <- read_csv("data/items_to_remove/bds_opentext_nonlang.csv", col_names=FALSE)$X1

  select(-all_of(bds_cols_to_remove)) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/4_apriori_removals/bds_4_apriori_removals.csv")
```

## Remove items with more than 20% NA values

### Inspect missingness

```{r}

bds_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(bds_unordered_removed))
bds_na_by_col

beq_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(beq_unordered_removed))
beq_na_by_col

blp_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(blp_unordered_removed))
blp_na_by_col

bsq_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(bsq_unordered_removed))
bsq_na_by_col

leapq_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(leapq_unordered_removed))
leapq_na_by_col

lhq_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(lhq_unordered_removed))
lhq_na_by_col

lsbq_na_by_col <- colSums(is.na(lsbq_unordered_removed))
lsbq_na_by_col
```

### Remove items exceeding 20% missingness threshold

```{r}

# set removal threshold at 20% of rows

if (length((bds_cols_to_remove_missingness)) > 0) {
  write((bds_cols_to_remove_missingness), "data/items_to_remove/bds_missingness_removals.csv", ncolumns = 1)
```

## Reverse-code AoA items

Items related to age of acquisition (AoA) are reverse coded such that higher values correspond to lower AoA. This creates consistency with all other items, for which higher values mean a higher degree of bilingualism, facilitating directional interpretation of analysis outputs.

WHAT ABOUT ACCENT ITEMS? Should reverse-code the L2 accent items where higher number means stronger accent.

### Identify items to reverse-code

There are 17 items across 5 questionnires (all but the BEQ and BSwQ) related to various aspects of age of acquisition. We reverse-code these items.

There is one item in the LHQ that asks about foreign accent in L2. In this item, "extreme" foreign accent is the scale maximum. We reverse-code this item. Note that we do not reverse-code the LEAP-Q L2 accent item, which has "foreign" as the scale minimum and "native" as the maximum.

```{r}

# to do: look at all questionnaires here
all_columns <- c(
  colnames(bds_nzv_removed),
  colnames(beq_nzv_removed),
  colnames(blp_nzv_removed),
  colnames(bsq_nzv_removed),
  colnames(lhq_nzv_removed),
  colnames(lsbq_nzv_removed),
  colnames(leapq_nzv_removed)
)

aoa_questions <- grep("aoa", all_columns, value = TRUE)
age_questions <- grep("age", all_columns, value = TRUE)

cols_to_reverse_code_age <- c(aoa_questions, age_questions)

bds_cols_to_rev_code <- cols_to_reverse_code_age[startsWith(cols_to_reverse_code_age, "bds")]
blp_cols_to_rev_code <- cols_to_reverse_code_age[startsWith(cols_to_reverse_code_age, "blp")]
leapq_cols_to_rev_code <- cols_to_reverse_code_age[startsWith(cols_to_reverse_code_age, "leapq")]
lhq_cols_to_rev_code <- cols_to_reverse_code_age[startsWith(cols_to_reverse_code_age, "lhq")]
lsbq_cols_to_rev_code <- cols_to_reverse_code_age[startsWith(cols_to_reverse_code_age, "lsbq")]

cols_about_accent <- grep("accent", all_columns, value = TRUE)
# only lhq_L2_foreign_accent_strength
lhq_cols_to_rev_code <- c(lhq_cols_to_rev_code, "lhq_L2_foreign_accent_strength")
```

### BEQ and BSQ (nothing to reverse-code)

```{r}

beq_rev_coded <- beq_nzv_removed %>%
  write_csv(., 'data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/beq_8_reverse_coded.csv')

bsq_rev_coded <- bsq_nzv_removed %>%
  write_csv(., 'data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bsq_8_reverse_coded.csv')
```

### BDS

```{r}

# cols to fix:
# "bds_aoa_L2_1"
# "bds_age_comfortable_speaking_L2_1"

# aoa item: 4 possible choices (1-4) corresponding to age ranges
# to adjust: new_value = max - old value + min

# comfort item: 4 possible values (0-4 and NA)
# to adjust: new_value = max - old value + min
# NA should stay NA

bds_reversecoded <- bds_nzv_removed %>%
  mutate(bds_aoa_L2_1 = 4 - bds_aoa_L2_1 + 1,
         bds_age_comfortable_speaking_L2_1 = case_when(
           !is.na(bds_age_comfortable_speaking_L2_1) ~ 4 - bds_age_comfortable_speaking_L2_1 + 1)) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/bds_8_reverse_coded.csv")
```

### BLP

```{r}

# cols to fix:
# "blp_L2_aoa"
# "blp_L1_age_became_comfortable"
# "blp_L2_age_became_comfortable"

# aoa question: 21 possible choices (0-20) corresponding to age
# to adjust: new_value = max - old value + min

# comfort questions: 21 possible values (1-20+ and "not yet")
# to adjust: reverse code the numeric values as above; "not yet" stays as "NA"

blp_reversecoded <- blp_nzv_removed %>%
  mutate(blp_L2_aoa = 20 - blp_L2_aoa,
         blp_L1_age_became_comfortable = case_when(
           !is.na(blp_L1_age_became_comfortable) ~ 20 - blp_L1_age_became_comfortable),
         blp_L2_age_became_comfortable = case_when(
           !is.na(blp_L2_age_became_comfortable) ~ 20 - blp_L2_age_became_comfortable)) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/blp_8_reverse_coded.csv")
```

### LEAP-Q

```{r}

# cols to fix:
# "leapq_aoa_reading_L1"
# "leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L1" 
# "leapq_age_reading_fluently_L1"
# "leapq_aoa_L2"
# "leapq_aoa_reading_L2"         
# "leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L2"
# "leapq_age_reading_fluently_L2"

# L1 questions: 4 answers (1-4); flip as above

# L2 questions: 5 answers (1-4 and NA)

leapq_reversecoded <- leapq_nzv_removed %>%
  mutate(leapq_aoa_reading_L1 = 4 - leapq_aoa_reading_L1 + 1,
         leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L1 = 4 - leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L1 + 1,
         leapq_age_reading_fluently_L1 = 4 - leapq_age_reading_fluently_L1 + 1,
         leapq_aoa_L2 = case_when(
           is.na(leapq_aoa_L2) ~ NA,
           !is.na(leapq_aoa_L2) ~ 4 - leapq_aoa_L2 + 1),
         leapq_aoa_reading_L2 = case_when(
           is.na(leapq_aoa_reading_L2) ~ NA,
           !is.na(leapq_aoa_reading_L2) ~ 4 - leapq_aoa_reading_L2 + 1),
         leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L2 = case_when(
           is.na(leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L2) ~ NA,
           !is.na(leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L2) ~ 4 - leapq_age_fluency_achieved_L2 + 1),
         leapq_age_reading_fluently_L2 = case_when(
           is.na(leapq_age_reading_fluently_L2) ~ NA,
           !is.na(leapq_age_reading_fluently_L2) ~ 4 - leapq_age_reading_fluently_L2 + 1)
  ) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/leapq_8_reverse_coded.csv")
```

### LHQ

```{r}

# cols to fix:
# "lhq_L2_aoa"
# "lhq_L2_age_first_speaking"
# "lhq_L2_age_first_reading"
# "lhq_L2_age_first_writing"
# "lhq_L2_foreign_accent_strength"

# all aoa items have 4 options (1-4), which just need to be reversed
# the accent question has 7 options (1-7)

lhq_reversecoded <- lhq_nzv_removed %>%
  mutate(lhq_L2_aoa = 4 - lhq_L2_aoa + 1,
         lhq_L2_age_first_speaking = 4 - lhq_L2_age_first_speaking + 1,
         lhq_L2_age_first_reading = 4 - lhq_L2_age_first_reading + 1,
         lhq_L2_age_first_writing = 4 - lhq_L2_age_first_writing + 1,
         lhq_L2_foreign_accent_strength = 7 - lhq_L2_foreign_accent_strength + 1) %>%
  write_csv(., "data/questionnaires/8_reverse_coded/lhq_8_reverse_coded.csv")

```
